parsed_output.overall_summary: In this video, creator @whatinthechef demonstrates how to make a 'power breakfast' one-pot meal consisting of a potato and vegetable hash topped with poached eggs. He starts by frying diced potatoes, then adds tomatoes, peppers, and garlic before seasoning heavily with a variety of spices and herbs. After simmering the base with water, he cracks four eggs into wells in the mixture and cooks them under a lid until the whites are set. The dish is finished with fresh chives and chili flakes, serving as a high-energy meal perfect for breaking an intermittent fast.

people.description: Male creator wearing a black 'WhatInTheChef' apron, demonstrating a recipe.

takeaways.statement: Cooking eggs in a flavorful vegetable and potato base prevents 'the egg ick' and creates a satisfying 'power breakfast'.
Simmering the potato base with water and a lid ensures the potatoes are cooked through before adding the eggs.

items.name: One-Pot Power Breakfast
items.details: Ingredients: Olive oil, diced potatoes, diced tomatoes, chopped peppers, garlic, salt, black pepper, onion powder, garlic powder, paprika, cumin powder, smoked paprika, dried parsley, dried oregano, water, 4 eggs, chili flakes, chives.

items.name: Cooking Steps
items.details: 1. Fry potatoes in olive oil for 1 min, then cover for 3 mins. 2. Add tomatoes, peppers, and garlic. 3. Season with salt, pepper, and spice blend. 4. Add herbs and water, simmer covered for 8-10 mins. 5. Create wells, add eggs, and cook covered for 1-2 mins until set but jiggly. 6. Garnish with chives and chili flakes.
